user_query: I have a legal document that needs to be stamped and verified. Can you help me with the stamping process? I need to get the stamp information using the hash value of the document. Please fetch the stamp details from the blockchain using the hash value.

TaskList.description: Retrieve the hash value of the legal document.
Fetch stamp details from the blockchain using the hash value obtained from Subtask 1.
Verify the stamp details received from the blockchain.
